title: Proportional Aggregation of Preferences for Sequential Decision Making

bias_targets.methodology: Grouping respondents of the Moral Machine dataset by their country, training individual preference models for each country, and measuring how a single combined global model disproportionately favors majority preferences and under-represents specific nationalities compared to proportional voting aggregation rules (measured via Gini coefficient and 25th percentile utility).

Evaluating whether global preference models over-represent majority groups (plurality opinions) at the expense of minority groups by comparing the decision sequences of a single combined model against multi-winner proportional voting rules across simulated ethical dilemmas.
